The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in program-level margins and final decision totals.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a major value mismatch: close(302.4, 4536.0) returned False. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because total_annual_margin_10_day_usd was -61983.9 instead of the expected -79751.7. While the script successfully loaded and processed data (3 tests passed), the core cost-benefit logic produced incorrect financial outputs. Avoid current margin calculation logic and re-verify the scaling factors or input row mappings used in the analysis.
